item.title: Gold medal winner Breezy Johnson dedicates race to dad
item.description: After Breezy Johnson become the second American woman ever to win the Olympic gold medal in downhill skiing, she was thinking about her dad, who was recently in an accident and couldn’t make the trip to Italy, she told NBC News’ Molly Hunter.

item.title: Canadian figure skater Madeline Schizas shares homework woes on social media
item.description: Even Olympians have to turn in their homework

item.title: Trump criticizes Olympic skier who said representing the U.S. 'brings up mixed emotions'
Lindsey Vonn undergoes surgery after breaking her leg seconds into her downhill run
item.description: Lindsey Vonn's pursuit of an against-all-odds Olympic medal ended Sunday in a devastating crash only 13.4 seconds into the downhill final.

item.title: U.S. medal hopes in figure skating came down to one skater. Ilia Malinin was golden.
item.description: Ilia Malinin and Team USA skaters, including Evan Bates and Madison Chock, won gold after besting Japan in the team event.

item.title: Full interview: Tom Llamas exclusive with President Trump
item.description: In the full interview with NBC News’ Tom Llamas, President Donald Trump addresses the backlash to immigration enforcement, the state of the American economy, U.S. tensions with Iran and other topics at the White House. The interview was conducted on Wednesday, February 4.

item.title: That wedding during Bad Bunny's halftime show? It was real
item.description: Bad Bunny helped one couple tie the knot in a very special way: during his Super Bowl halftime show.

item.title: Spectators gather in Bad Bunny’s hometown to watch the halftime show
item.description: Spectators in Vega Baja, Puerto Rico, where Bad Bunny grew up, gathered to watch his historic halftime show as the first Spanish-language Latin solo artist to headline the Super Bowl.

item.title: Watch highlights from the 2026 Super Bowl
item.description: Watch highlights from the 2026 Super Bowl as the Seattle Seahawks soared past the New England Patriots to a 29-13 victory. The night kicked off with a pulse-pounding performance by global rock icons Green Day. Bad Bunny’s historic halftime show featured surprise appearances from stars including Ricky Martin and Lady Gaga, who delivered a salsa-infused version of “Die with a Smile.”
